### One of the best meals of my trip to Vietnam! 🇻🇳
Jul 2026 • Couples
---

If you are in Hoi An, you absolutely must visit **Cơm Linh**. Without exaggeration, this was one of the best meals I had during my entire trip to Vietnam!

Here is why this place easily deserves 5 stars:

* **Lightning-fast service:** There was a queue outside (always a good sign!), but we only waited about **10 minutes** to get a table. Once seated, our food arrived in just **5 minutes**. Incredible efficiency and speed!
* **Exceptional quality:** Every dish was prepared with incredibly fresh, flavorful, and high-quality ingredients. Each bite was a true explosion of authentic local flavors.
* **Great value for money:** Outstanding food at a very reasonable price.

> **Highly recommended:** If you are looking for authentic local cuisine, fast service, and great prices in Hoi An, don't miss this place!

Totally overrated. A huge disappointment and a rip off
Feb 2026 • Couples
We were recommended this place. So good that people are willing to queue get in! Frankly, don't waste your time. 
We ordered a starter and two mains (two soups) They all arrived at the same time. The starter was as big as the main and also turned out to be a soup... We obviously had misunderstood the description but this should have been flagged up by the waitress. Our mains were lukewarm , whilst the starter was scolding hot. I had ordered a Vietnamese tea as a drink which arrived barely tepid. And last but not least the food was bland, tasteless and the meat rubbery. The worst meal for us so far in our 4-week travelling through Cambodia and Vietnam. To crown it all, they wanted to charge us 8% for paying with a card. The going rate in Vietnam is 3%... My husband argued with the owner who wouldn't back down, claiming 8% was government tax... complete lie as no other place in Vietnam had ever charged us this amount. In the end we paid cash as the owner just wouldn't have it. Avoid it at all
